title: Product Hunt Launches & Maker Leads Enricher Input

source.title: Launch Source
source.description: both = Product Hunt + Hacker News Show HN launches (recommended). product_hunt = Product Hunt daily launches. show_hn = Hacker News Show HN launches.

maxItems.title: Max Items to Extract
maxItems.description: Maximum number of daily launches to extract and enrich (default 50).

enrichWebsites.title: Enrich Startup Websites
enrichWebsites.description: If true, follows the startup's live website redirect to extract founder emails, social links (Twitter/X, Discord, GitHub), and marketing pixels.

filterKeywords.title: Filter Keywords (Optional)
filterKeywords.description: Optional list of keywords to filter products by title or tagline (e.g. ['AI', 'SaaS', 'Marketing', 'Developer Tools']). Leave empty to get all launches.
